import subprocess as _sp

def osa(script):
    _r = _sp.run(["osascript", "-e", script], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if _r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("AppleScript: " + _r.stderr.strip()
                           + " (выдайте роботу доступ: Настройки → Конфиденциальность → Универсальный доступ)")
    return _r.stdout.strip()

_text = "%s = %s" % (expression, result)
_safe = _text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')
osa('tell application "Pages" to activate')
osa('tell application "Pages" to set _doc to make new document')
osa('tell application "Pages" to set body text of front document to "%s"' % _safe)
_check = osa('tell application "Pages" to get body text of front document')
if _check.strip() != _text:
    raise RuntimeError("Текст не попал в документ Pages: %r" % _check)
log("Вставлено в Pages: " + _text)
